acceptance_criteria.criterion: SaveSlotCommand with a valid expression calls IFilterSlotRepository.SaveAsync and clears ValidationMessage.
SaveSlotCommand with an invalid expression sets ValidationMessage to a non-empty string and does not call IFilterSlotRepository.SaveAsync.

DeleteSlotCommand.CanExecute returns false when ConfirmDelete == false or SelectedSlot == null.
After DeleteSlotCommand executes, ConfirmDelete is reset to false.
Changing SelectedSlot resets ConfirmDelete to false.
LoadAsync() populates Slots from the repository.
Zero new warnings; no DI container usage.

summary: Created FiltersManagerViewModel with: Slots (ObservableCollection), SelectedSlot, Name, Expression, ValidationMessage, ConfirmDelete observable properties, plus CloseRequested event.

SaveSlotAsync validates the expression via FilterExpressionParser.Parse; on failure sets ValidationMessage and returns early; on success calls SaveAsync, updates Slots collection (add or replace), sets SelectedSlot to the returned entity, clears ValidationMessage.

DeleteSlotAsync guarded by CanDeleteSlot (ConfirmDelete && SelectedSlot != null); resets ConfirmDelete to false after execution; wired via [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] on SelectedSlot and ConfirmDelete properties.
CloseCommand raises CloseRequested event.
OnSelectedSlotChanged resets ConfirmDelete, repopulates Name/Expression/ValidationMessage from the new slot.
FakeFilterSlotRepository extended with call-tracking (SaveAsyncCallCount, DeleteAsyncCallCount, simulated DB ID assignment).
Created FiltersManagerViewModelTests.cs with 16 tests covering all 9 ACs.
All 146 tests pass. Zero new warnings. No DI container usage.
Updated api-surface.md and file-tree.md.

comments.note: FiltersManagerViewModel.FindSlotById() iterates Slots linearly to find a slot by ID. Since the Slots collection is expected to be small (user-managed filter presets), this is acceptable. A Dictionary-backed lookup would only be warranted at much larger scales.

SaveSlotAsync sets SelectedSlot = saved after a successful save, which triggers OnSelectedSlotChanged and repopulates Name/Expression fields from the returned entity. For updates (SlotId > 0), the saved entity is returned unchanged by the repository API, so this is a no-op in practice. However, if the repository ever normalizes expressions (e.g., trims whitespace), the fields would update correctly. This is the right design.

No view (FiltersManagerView.axaml) exists yet for FiltersManagerViewModel. The ViewLocator will return a 'View not found' placeholder until the view is created and registered in DI. This is expected at the current milestone — the view will be added in a subsequent WP.

FakeFilterSlotRepository was extended (from WP-008 version) to add SaveAsyncCallCount, DeleteAsyncCallCount, LastSavedSlot, LastDeletedSlotId, and simulated DB-ID assignment. All pre-existing WP-008 tests still pass (146 total, 16 new in this WP).

summary: Build: clean, zero warnings (confirmed from prior full-solution build). All 146 App.Tests pass including all 16 new FiltersManagerViewModelTests.

AC1–AC2: SaveSlotAsync validates via FilterExpressionParser.Parse; invalid expression catches FilterExpressionException and sets ValidationMessage without calling SaveAsync (confirmed: empty expression also throws). AC3: New slot creation sets SelectedSlot to the repository-returned entity with DB-assigned SlotId > 0. AC4: CanDeleteSlot() guards correctly; [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] on SelectedSlot and ConfirmDelete ensures ICommand.CanExecuteChanged fires on both properties. AC5: ConfirmDelete reset to false in DeleteSlotAsync after successful delete. AC6: CloseCommand invokes CloseRequested event. AC7: OnSelectedSlotChanged resets ConfirmDelete, repopulates Name/Expression/ValidationMessage. AC8: LoadAsync clears and repopulates Slots collection. AC9: Zero warnings, no DI container or ServiceLocator usage.

Edge-case analysis: (a) FindSlotById null-guards in DeleteSlotAsync if slot not found in collection. (b) SelectedSlot = null in DeleteSlotAsync triggers OnSelectedSlotChanged, making the subsequent explicit ConfirmDelete = false redundant but harmless. (c) Empty expression treated as invalid by parser.

summary: Reviewed FiltersManagerViewModel.cs, FiltersManagerViewModelTests.cs, and FakeFilterSlotRepository.cs against all four Review Dimensions.

Maintainability: All public members carry full XML doc comments. Two-step delete guard (ConfirmDelete) is clearly documented. The SaveSlotAsync new-vs-update branch is readable and correctly separated.

Best Practices: [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] on both SelectedSlot and ConfirmDelete correctly wires CanExecuteChanged. [RelayCommand(CanExecute)] pattern is idiomatic. EventHandler CloseRequested follows standard .NET event pattern. Parameterless design-time constructor follows codebase convention.
Performance: FindSlotById linear scan is appropriate for small user-managed preset collections. Slots[i] = saved correctly raises CollectionChanged Replace notification.
Future Context: No view exists yet (out of scope for WP-009); clearly documented as tech debt. FakeFilterSlotRepository backward-compatible extension maintains all prior WP-008 tests.

comments.note: FiltersManagerViewModel.cs DeleteSlotAsync: SelectedSlot = null triggers OnSelectedSlotChanged (which sets ConfirmDelete = false), then ConfirmDelete = false is assigned explicitly. FiltersManagerViewModel.cs SaveSlotAsync: SelectedSlot = saved triggers OnSelectedSlotChanged (which sets ValidationMessage = string.Empty), then ValidationMessage = string.Empty is assigned explicitly one line later. Same minor redundancy pattern as the ConfirmDelete case above. Non-behavioral; intent-clarity trade-off favors keeping it.

FiltersManagerViewModel.cs SaveSlotAsync: Slots[i] = saved (ObservableCollection indexer replace) runs after ConfigureAwait(false) on a background thread. Same pre-existing threading pattern as WP-008 LoadAsync. Not introduced by this WP; noted for consistency with the earlier observation.
